classification.source_level_rationale: created in the course of the activity it documents: This is a contemporary administrative record of a parliamentary interpellation debate.
classification.resume: This record documents a 2015 Ständerat debate on the Regio-Express train service between St. Gallen and Konstanz, initiated by Paul Rechsteiner. It includes speeches by several senators and is part of the official session protocols. The debate focused on regional rail transport between Switzerland and Germany.
